claim: Fit normalized robust residuals in dB instead of inverting into biased, heteroscedastic ranges
mechanism: Same receiver calibration, public-layout bounded multi-start Huber in RSSI space
why_now: Receiver intercept calibration only 1.07% gain; inversion mismatch may dominate remaining tails
